description: Start standalone Image generation from a lightweight text prompt, creating a new Mint chat unless chat_id is supplied. project_id is required when chat_id is absent; when both are supplied they must match. This is a final-only exploration capability with no preview approval gate, prompt-guidance workflow, provider/model picker, or required reference image. Show chatUrl as the Open in Mint link and keep assetId for get_asset, wait_for_status, start_image_edit, and artifact follow-up. For code-project imports, follow nextSteps through wait_for_status and get_asset_artifact_manifest. Do not expose raw asset ids unless the user asks. If status is billing_required, generationStarted is false: use billing.userMessage as the core user response, explain the account entitlement or credit shortfall without promoting subscriptions, upgrades, or credit purchases, and present billing.chatUrl as a blocked request that can resume after billing is resolved. Do not call it a failed generation.
name: start_image_generation
title: Start Image Generation
